summary: V5 feature testing: registration trial flow, trial banner, admin top performers, export CSV, bottom tab sizes. Fixed critical bug: missing @api_router.get decorator on admin_reports_summary function causing Admin Overview tab to be blank.

critical.issue: Missing @api_router.get('/admin/reports/summary') decorator before the function definition. Fixed by adding the decorator.

action_items: BUG FIXED: Added missing @api_router.get('/admin/reports/summary') decorator in server.py (line 961). The Admin Overview tab was blank because the endpoint returned 404.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 961: admin_reports_summary function was missing its route decorator, causing Admin Overview tab to show blank. Fixed in this iteration.
seed_data_creation: Registered 2 trial test users during testing (TEST_Trial Vet, TEST New Trial) with trial mobiles 9778537021 and 9778537326
context_for_next_testing_agent: V5 all working. Registration → dashboard directly (trial banner shows '3 days left'). Demo user has no trial banner. Admin panel Overview tab now shows stats (was broken, fixed). Top Performers tab shows ranked users with TRIAL/SUSPENDED badges, toggles between By Cases and By Earnings. Bottom tabs are compact (52-58px). Export & Share via WhatsApp button present on Top tab.
rca_of_issue: Admin Overview tab was blank. RCA: In server.py, the function admin_reports_summary (line 961) was missing the @api_router.get('/admin/reports/summary') decorator. The function body was present but not registered as a route, causing 404 responses. Fix: Added the decorator @api_router.get('/admin/reports/summary') before the function definition and restarted backend.
